paite: Hiai thute Jordan suahlam gamdai, Paran leh Tophelen Laban leh Hazeroth leh Dizahab kikal a Suph chin a Arabah a Mosi in Israel mi tengteng kiang a agen ahi.
heading: Putlakna

paite: Horeb tang a kipan Kadesh-barnea, Seir tang lam lampi tawn a pai in ni sawm-le-khat lam ahi.
Akum sawmlina, akha sawm-le-khatna, huai kha ani khat ni in, hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N amau hilh dia thu apiak tengteng Israel kiang ah Mosi in agen hi.
Heshbon a om Amorte kumpipa Sihon leh Edrei leh Astaroth a om Bashan kumpipa Og athah nung in;
Jordan suahlam Moab gam ah hiai dan Mosi in hiai bang in agenchian panta hi.
TOUPA i Pathian un Horeb tang ah ahon houpih a, "Hiai tang ah na om sawt huntawkta uhi.
Kisuan unla, paikhia unla, Amorte tanggam ah leh akimvel teng Arabah ah, tanggamte ah, phaizang gam leh Lebanon ah, Luipi Euphrates tan in pai un.
Ngai un, gam ka hon pe khin a; na pu uh Abraham, Isak, Jakob leh amaute nung a, asuansawnte uh kiang a kichiam a TOUPA'N apiak gam va luah un," achi hi.
Huai lai in na kiang uah, "Kei kia in ka hon po zou kei.
heading: Mosi In Vaihawmte Asep

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon pungsak a, ngai un, tu in na tamdan uh van a aksi zah hial ahong hita hi.
TOUPA, na pi-le-pute Pathian in tu sang in amun sang tamtak in hon pungsak henla, hon chiam bang in hon vualzawl hen.
Bangchi in kei kia in na buainate uh, na puakgikte uh, na kihoutheih louhnate uh ka po zou dia?
Na nam lak ua mi, mipil, theisiammi, adan ding thei mi kitelkhia unla, na tung ua heutu ding in ka bawl ding," ka chi hi.
Nou, "Na thil gen kou a ding in ahoih mahmah," chi in na hon dawng uhi.

Huchi in na nam heutute uh ka la a, na nam lak ua mi, mipil, dan thei mite na tung ua heutu in ka bawl hi: sangkhatte tung a heutute, zakhatte tung a heutute, sawmngate tung a heutute, sawmkhatte tung a heutute, intekpente toh.
Huai lai in na vaihawmte uh kiang ah, "Na unaute uh kal a thu kingaihkhiaksak unla, unau leh unau kikal ah leh gamdangmi, a-ompih toh akal uah diktattak in vai hawm un.

Vaihawmna ah deihsak tuam na nei ding uh ahi kei. Mineu leh milian kibang a na ngaihkhiaksak ding uh ahi. Kuamah na lau ding uh ahi kei. Vaihawmna lah Pathian a ahi ngal a. Nou a dia thuhaksa luate ka kiang ah na hon tun zel ding ua, huai ka ngaikhe zel ding," chi in thu ka pia hi.
Huai lai in na thilhih ding tengteng uah thu ka hon pia hi.
TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in Horeb tang a pan i pawt ua, Amorte tanggam lampi a gamdai zapi leh mulkimhuaitak na muh uh i kantan ua, Kadesh-barnea khua i va tung uhi.
heading: Kadesh-barnea A Pan Enkhe Mite Sawlna

paite: Na kiang uah, "TOUPA i Pathian in hon piak Amorte tanggam na hong tungta uhi.
Ngai dih ua, TOUPA na Pathian un gam ahon pe khinta hi. Hohtou unla, TOUPA na pi-le-pute Pathian in ana gen khitsa bang in va luahtou un. Lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un," ka hon chi hi.
Ka kiang ah na hong pai vek ua, "Agam va enkhia a, i hohtouhna ding lampi leh i hohna ding kho tanchinte hong hilh nawn ding in i ma uah mi sawl leng," na chi uhi.
Huai thu in hon kipaksak a; huchi in na lak ua mi sawm-le-nih, nam khat a khat zel ka tel hi.
Huchi in apawtta ua, tang ah akahtou ua, Eshkol Phaizang ava tung ua, ava enkhe vek uhi.
Huai gam a theite alou ua, ahon puak ua, tanchin hon tun ua, "TOUPA i Pathian hon gam piak hoih petmah ahi," achi uhi.
Himahleh na hohtou nuam kei ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak na helsan uhi.
Na puaninte uah na phun ua, "TOUPA'N ahon huat ziak in hon hihmang dia, Amorte khut a hon pe ding in Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia ahi.

Koi lai ah ahia i hohtouh ding? I unaute'n, mihing ei sang in alianzaw ua, san leng asangzaw ua; khuate alian a, van sun in kulh anei uh. Anak tapate leng i mu a, chi in hon lung kesak uh," na chi uhi.
Ke'n na kiang uah, "Amaute kihta kei unla, lauh leng lau sam kei un.
TOUPA na Pathian na makaipa un na mitmuh ua Aigupta gam a hon hihsak tengteng bang in ahon doupih ding.
Gamdai ah leng mi'n ata apuak bang a TOUPA na Pathian un hiai mun na tun tan un lamtawn a hon puakdan na mu ding uhi, ka chi hi.
Himahleh hiai thil ah TOUPA na Pathian uh na gingta kei uh.
Na puanin na zak ding uh hon zonsak ding leh na lampi uh hon kawkmuh dia zan a meikuang a, sun a meipi a na ma uh pipa na muang kei uhi."
TOUPA'N na thugen uh aza a, aheh a, akichiam hi.
heading: TOUPA'N Israel Agawt / (Nam 14.20-45)

paite: "Hiai suan giloutak lak a mi khat mahmah in leng na pi-le-pute uh pe dia ka kichiamna gam hoih petmah amu kei ding uh,
Jephunneh tapa Kaleb kia ngal lou in. Ama'n zaw amu dia, ava sik gam amah leh atate ka pe ding, ama'n alungtang tengteng a TOUPA azuih ziak in," achi hi.
Noute ziak in ka tung ah TOUPA aheh a, "Nang leng huai ah na lut kei ding,
na nasempa Nun tapa Joshua bel alut ding. Amah hanthawn in, Israelte alutsak ding hi.
"Na taneute uh, gallak in ala mai ding uh, na chihte uleh, tua asia-apha thei nai lou na tate uh alut ding ua, amau zaw ka pe dia, aluah ding uhi.
Nou ahihleh kihei unla, Tuipi San lam ah gamdai ah pai un," achi hi.

Nou, "TOUPA tung ah i na khialta uh, i hohtou ding ua, TOUPA i Pathian in thu hon piak tengteng bang in i va dou ding uh," chi in na hon dawng ua, huchi in kidouna van in na kivan chiat ua, tang a hohtouh thil neuchik in na ngaihtuah uhi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hohtou kei un. Va dou sam kei un, na lak uah ka om kei hi. Na melmate un hon na that kha ding uh, akiang uah chi in," ahon chi hi.
Huai ka hon hilh a, na ngaikhe kei ua, TOUPA thupiak na helsan zawta ua, tang ah na hohtou teitei uhi.
Huai tang ah Amorte'n hon na dou ua, khuai midelh bang in hon delh ua, Seir a pan Hormah tan in hon that uhi.
Na hong kik nawn ua, TOUPA ma ah na kap ua; himahleh TOUPA'N na aw uh angaikhe kei a, abil leng ahon doh sam kei hi.
Huchi in huai a na om sung uh ngaihtuah in Kadesh ah sawtpi na taam uhi.
